intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按工程时间线跟读：1858 年法国工程师带着 Channel Tunnel 计划来到英国；平台 would serve as a port and railway station；chimneys 让 tunnel well-ventilated；William Low 的 double railway-tunnel was put forward；最后用 had not feared invasion 和 officially opened 读出历史延迟与最终连接。读的时候注意 Aime Thome de Gamond、twenty-one-mile、would serve as、well-ventilated、was put forward、should be built、feared invasion 和 European continent。

sentences.text: In 1858, a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：1858 年，一位法国工程师带着穿越英吉利海峡的隧道计划来到英国。长句分成 with a plan / for a tunnel / under the English Channel 三段，专名自然读过即可。

sentences.text: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他认为可以在海峡中央建一座平台。Would be possible 要连成一个想法，in the centre of the Channel 说明位置。

sentences.text: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这个平台会用作港口和火车站。Would serve as 是本课核心结构，后面两个用途 port 和 railway station 要读清楚。

sentences.text: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：如果在海平面以上建造高烟囱，隧道就会通风良好。Well-ventilated 四个音节稳住，if 后面是条件。

sentences.text: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：1860 年，一个英国人 William Low 提出了更好的计划。Was put forward 是被动表达，William Low 作为专名自然收尾。

sentences.text: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他建议建一条双轨铁路隧道。Suggested that 后面接方案内容，should be built 要读出“应该被建造”。

sentences.text: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：如果当时英国人没有害怕入侵，隧道本来会完成。If 后面轻停，had not feared 和 would have been completed 搭配表达没有发生的过去。

sentences.text: It was officially opened on March 7,1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它于 1994 年 3 月 7 日正式开通，最终把英国和欧洲大陆连在一起。Officially opened 稳住重音，finally connecting 读出最终实现的感觉。
